# Censor lab results

<!-- Generated by `make lab` (TestCensorMatrix); do not edit. -->

Did a transport's data cross the censor in the lab router, device-a to server-1: pass when it crossed over IPv4 and over IPv6, fail when it crossed over neither (one family alone is partial, which no cell expects: the run fails and this file is not written). Every cell is probed. The `(control)` rows are not transports: they show that plain TCP and HTTPS on the underlay cross the censor, and that the censor sees them. The `(reference)` rows are real WireGuard and OpenVPN, which the fingerprint modules must block.
